Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Current state: Last confirmed observation was Thu 11, 8:20 p.m., raining, at the east end of Pelican Town’s southern cobblestone road beside a large blue building. A clear dirt path continued south. A subsequent S hold for 2.0 seconds completed, but its resulting position/time were not supplied. Energy was full and funds were 218g.

Active goal: Meet Willy at the beach south of Pelican Town and receive his promised item. The journal’s “To The Beach” entry said to visit before 5:00 p.m.; repeated attempts arrived after that time, so Willy’s later availability remains unknown. “Introductions” was listed but never opened. No beach arrival, Willy meeting, reward, fishing, farming, combat, or shopping has occurred.

Observed controls/mechanics: WASD moves; A wakes the farmer. X checks objects and opened the mailbox when approached from below with left+X; Esc closed mail after X failed. M opens/closes the map. F opened/closed the journal, and clicking “To The Beach” showed its details. Clicking Yes on the sleep dialog advanced from Tue afternoon to Wed morning; clicking No dismisses it without sleeping. Exterior transitions can briefly darken the screen. Held inputs consume substantial, variable game time; short inputs occasionally produced no visible displacement. Doorways and roads sometimes require precise alignment.

Confirmed map/location information: Research Farm is west-center. The southeast coastal building with a dock is the Fish Shop, with displayed hours 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. The map showed a river bridge east of town and a route continuing south toward the beach. It is only a hypothesis that the currently discovered southbound dirt path connects to that beach route.

Reliable farm-to-town navigation: Exit through the farmhouse’s bottom-left doorway; diagonal down-left alignment was needed on one attempt. Descend the central porch stairs—the right porch edge is blocked. Direct east at the lower farm level is blocked by shrubs/tree. Instead skirt obstacles diagonally up-right toward the mailbox, reach its clear dirt path, then hold east through the farm transition. Continue east along the fenced bus-stop road and paved approach to the cobblestone junction west of town. Take the southeast branch, descend beside the fountain, skirt the left lamp post down-right onto the central vertical path, and continue to the southern east–west road.

Newly confirmed town movement: At the southern junction, align precisely on the horizontal cobblestones before holding east; short N/S adjustments help avoid overshooting into grass. Once centered on Thu 11, D holds successfully moved east: at 7:40 p.m. the farmer reached a northbound path beside a bench, and at 8:20 p.m. reached the large blue building and clear southbound dirt path. This is farther than earlier attempts, but no river crossing or beach transition has yet been observed.

Failed routes/strategies: Continuing east through town’s main road past the clinic/timber building previously ended at 1:20 a.m. on a narrow grassy bank west of a river, not the beach. Going south from the southern town junction entered a wooded river area directly south of town; backtracking north worked. Holding east while below the road left the farmer in grass near graves/flowers, apparently obstructed. Earlier short eastward attempts at the junction produced no visible progress before an overnight reset; later successful movement showed centering on the cobblestones matters. Northern farm-road and other town branches remain untried.

Timing/overnight evidence: Multiple late outings ended in indoor morning resets with full energy and declining funds: 500g→450g→405g→365g→329g→297g→268g→242g→218g. Association with late nights is observed, but the exact cause and any 2:00 a.m. collapse are unconfirmed. Sleeping Tuesday to obtain an early Wednesday start did not prevent another late reset. Thursday began at 6:00 a.m., but farmhouse exit was reached around 9:00 a.m., town junction at 1:30 p.m., and southern road around 5:00 p.m.; thus even an early departure did not meet the journal/Fish Shop times. Reaching Willy after 5:00 p.m. remains worth testing but is unverified.
